questions.text:
Analyse how the structure of the text fulfilled or ruined your expectations.

"Structure" may refer to the order, organisation, or conventions of a text.

Write an essay on at least ONE visual or oral text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology. Address how the text's structure fulfilled or subverted expectations (e.g. genre conventions, narrative arc, plot twists). Show awareness of deliberate crafting. Include specific details. Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of how structural choices create or undermine expectations. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about the relationship between structure and audience expectations, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s).
